subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm/mempolicy: limit shared policy ranges per inode

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Expressed concern that the patch is just delaying the inevitable issue of shared policy ranges. Suggested backporting an increase to the default size as a mitigation.

2026-11-16.patch_summary: The patch aims to limit shared policy ranges per inode in the mm/mempolicy module.
